subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship an experimental Rovo Dev provider that relies on Atlassian's undocumented credits/check endpoint and Basic-auth behavior?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a narrow code defect automation can safely choose; it is whether maintainers accept the provider contract and proof standard for an auth-sensitive external integration.

options.title: Hold for proof and sign-off
options.body: Require successful latest-head paid-account credit proof plus explicit maintainer acceptance of the endpoint/auth/site behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept disabled experimental risk
options.body: Merge the disabled-by-default provider with experimental documentation and own the risk that Atlassian rejects or changes the endpoint for normal accounts.

options.title: Pause for CLI/site-aware path
options.body: Leave the related provider request open until real CLI usage fixtures or a supported API make the integration less speculative.

recommendation.title: Hold for proof and sign-off
recommendation.body: Require successful latest-head paid-account credit proof plus explicit maintainer acceptance of the endpoint/auth/site behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the recent hardening commits and already made the provider-contract hold explicit in PR comments.
